headline: DepthGraft reports hierarchical cross-layer KV reconstruction with lower cache and prefill cost
summary: The authors propose hierarchical sharing of key/value (KV) representations across transformer depth, reconstructing deep-layer KV from aligned shallow and middle layers. In experiments on dense and MoE models from 0.5B to 16B parameters, they report a roughly one-third KV-cache reduction. For 9B MLA and 16B GQA models, the paper reports lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) at 8K–128K context and nearly unchanged time-per-output-token (TPOT); at 128K, reported TTFT reductions are 26.8% and 28.8%, respectively. These results are author-reported and have not been independently reproduced.
